LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_ExtractionNote: Disabling an Abnormality prevents it from being obtained through future extractions or Cogito injections. Existing individuals in your save remain unaffected.
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_EnableOneSin: Enable One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds (ZAYIN)
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_EnableWeCanChangeAnything: Enable We Can Change Anything (ZAYIN Tool)
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_EnableOldBelief: Enable Old Belief and Promise (ZAYIN Tool)
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_EnablePortrait: Enable Portrait of Another World (HE Tool)
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_PortraitAllowNonColonist: Allow prisoners and visitors as substitutes
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_PortraitAllowNonColonistD: When enabled, prisoners and friendly non-hostile humanlikes on the map can also be randomly marked as substitutes instead of only player colonists and slaves.
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_PortraitTransferMultDesc: Scales how much incoming damage is dealt to the marked substitute when the Portrait redirects harm from the bound ward.
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_IronMaidenAllowCancel: Allow canceling We Can Change Anything
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_IronMaidenAllowCancelDesc: When enabled, colonists ordered into We Can Change Anything can be pulled back out early instead of staying trapped until death.
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_OldBeliefDestroyEgo: Old Belief betrayal can destroy E.G.O weapons
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_OldBeliefDestroyEgoDesc: By default, authored E.G.O weapons only lose their blessing and inflict backlash on betrayal instead of being destroyed like ordinary weapons. Enable this to enforce strict annihilation on E.G.O weapons too.
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_BurrowingHeavenTeleportDe: When enabled, an escaped Burrowing Heaven that remains outside your camera view will teleport near a target after bursting.
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_BurrowingHeavenGraceDesc: Scales how long The Burrowing Heaven waits while unwatched before dropping its Qliphoth Counter or triggering a breach burst.
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_NothingThereAllowDisguise: Allow Form I disguised breach phase
When enabled, Nothing There first enters its eerie Form I disguised phase before morphing into a cocoon and True Form. Disabling this skips directly to Form II.
LanguageData.LCAbn_Settings_NothingThereHatchSecondsD: Real-time seconds required for Nothing There's immobile Form II cocoon to hatch into its invincible True Form.
